findings.evidence_quote: Data Type & Format: ISO 8601 date-time (UTC). Allowed Values: Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.
findings.reasoning: MAS defines the data element 'Event date (where applicable)' to report the occurrence of trade lifecycle events. Although named 'Event date', the specification explicitly defines its data type as ISO 8601 date-time (UTC) in the exact timestamp format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, satisfying the requirement without conflict.
